integrity: Formal geometric smoothness via polynomial gcd and weighted-coordinate isomorphisms; exact finite-field point counts through degree eight and Picard-rank-eight structural theorem yield zeta data for all extensions.
scientific_limitations: Explicit 32-model cyclic invariant family over F2 only; classification does not cover arbitrary characteristic-two del Pezzo surfaces. No independent validation.
title: Four Frobenius types among cyclic degree-two del Pezzo double planes over the two-element field
